battle-over-britain.evidence: Actual offered 42-page 6366810-byte WordPress-hosted PDF retrieved unchanged from Lev Mishkin’s February 8, 2009 collector post. Cover visually shows Battle Over Britain, Rules of Play, August 1940 The Luftwaffe Attacks, TSR and NAC branding. Spanish printed rulebook scan matches the original SPI/TSR August/September 1940 strategic campaign BGG 4278, not the Minden 2013 game. Collector describes a NAC Spanish edition circa 1985; exact publication date and translation credit not independently established. Accurate rules_reference_pdf because this file is only part of the manual: PDF2–3 contents list sections 1–44, PDF4–39 cover strategic sections 1–21 and start sections 22–23, then the combat sequence stops mid-sentence and three strategic record sheets follow at PDF40–42. No remaining combat/advanced chapters, full screen tables, map/counters or complete playable set recovered. All 42 pages have no native text. Spanish Tesseract OCR completed on all 42 at 2600-pixel page height; 205638 raw characters. Cover has zero auto-recognized characters and blank raid sheet PDF40 only 94; those are retained with explicit manual heading notes, not invented prose or reconstructed table cells. Pages 2–39 each exceed 1900 OCR characters. Cover, contents, introduction, final strategic victory page and last two record sheets visually inspected; setup/sequence, air-combat, strategic objectives/victory text read as samples. Not a line-by-line review of all 42 pages; OCR column order, numbers, tables and diagrams remain fallible and original PDF controls. Two unchanged collector/review components retain offered-link and identity provenance. Specific MAJOR: strategic turns are five days in a nine-turn campaign, contradicting the local summary’s portion-of-a-day turn scale. No complete summary audit, PASS or body repair.

battle-over-britain.specific_finding: The summary describes each game turn as a portion of a day while presenting the strategic campaign. The original Spanish NAC introduction (section 1.0, PDF4) and section 5.0 (PDF11) state that the strategic campaign consists of nine turns, each representing five days. The introduction distinguishes this from combat scenarios and the advanced game; those are separate systems, not a portion-of-a-day strategic turn. This changes the timing of raids, repair, activity and replacements. Specific MAJOR for strategic turn scale only. The recovered PDF is partial, missing the remaining combat/advanced chapters and screen tables; OCR exact values require the original scan. No full summary audit or body repair.
